description.value: The Keg Granville Island is a full-service steakhouse and bar situated on Granville Island, one of Vancouver's most visited waterfront destinations. The location features a dining room, bar with TVs, lounge, and patio, and is accessible by water taxi or ferry in addition to street-level entry. It is a reliable sit-down meal option for cyclists touring Vancouver's False Creek and Granville Island area.
